Sean — drafted suggested language and attached Redwood_Suggested_Publicity_Text.docx for insertion. High-level notes below; full redline in the doc.

Proposed bullets (summary):
- Press & Announcements: Customer may publicly disclose the existence of the relationship and issue press releases, product announcements, and case studies provided Customer submits the announcement materials to Redwood at least 5 business days prior to publication for review. Redwood's approval shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed; if Redwood does not respond within 5 business days, approval will be deemed granted.

- Logo & Trademark Use: Redwood grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use Redwood's name and logo solely to identify Customer's relationship with Redwood in a partner directory, sales materials, and joint marketing collateral, subject to Redwood's trademark guidelines. Any use in paid advertising or as a standalone endorsement requires prior written permission.

- Reference Rights: Customer may include Redwood in vendor lists and in one-line references (company name and product) without additional approval. Case studies, testimonials, and use of Redwood's logo for published joint content will follow the Press & Announcements clause's review SLA.

- Confidentiality carveout: Explicitly exclude aggregated usage metrics and anonymized case examples from "Confidential Information" so long as Customer does not include identifying customer data.

I think the 5 business day auto-grant is reasonable and preserves operational flow. If Novacorp insists on 10 days, recommend pushing back and offering reciprocity (5 days Redwood / 10 days Customer) only if their GC explains a specific legal constraint.

Attachment: Redwood_Suggested_Publicity_Text.docx (docx, 28KB)
